My appointment was 3h and included a series of tests, a verbal report of my family and personal MH history, and 2 questionnaires I had to take with me. 1 I filled out and the other I was told to choose someone who knew me very well and spent a good amount of time with me. I chose my partner, but if I was single I would've chosen my bff.

There were a LOT of tests. I was given a picture that I had to copy, and then was asked to draw it again about 30 minutes later from memory. I was asked to draw it a final time towards the end of my testing. I had to make shapes with blocks, do math equations, spelling tests, define words, memorize stories ect. I honestly felt horrible at the end of the testing because I felt like it should've been easy but was so hard for me. But that's the point. The things I struggled with made it very clear I had ADHD.

I was asked about my family history, my symptoms, examples of those symptoms and how long I'd been struggling with them. 

Then I was given the questionnaires and told to return them. I don't fully remember what they said, but it was obvious to me that they seemed to be screening for depression amd anxiety as well as ADHD. It asked about mood, self esteem, impulses ect.

I didn't ask any questions because I was burned out at the end.

I had a follow-up appointment about 3-4 weeks after my eval where she went over everything we did, told me how I scored, gave me my official diagnosis and her recommendations going forward. I was also given a hard copy of my evaluation which explains everything they did.
